# Roalla Business Enablement Group

> Digital Enablement partner in Burlington, Ontario, serving clients globally in English and French. ROALLA builds websites, digital products, automation, visibility optimization, digital events, and hosted team workshops. Delivery model: Prepare → Transform → Emerge → Soar.

## What ROALLA is
- Legal name: Roalla Business Enablement Group
- Site: https://www.roalla.com
- Founder: Steven Robin, Founder and Principal Consultant — https://www.roalla.com/en/about

- Contact: sales@roalla.com | +1-289-838-5868
- Languages: English (/en/) and French (/fr/)
- Experience stated on the site: 30+ years, 500+ engagements
- Inquiry: about 3 minutes, no obligation, personal reply within one business day — https://www.roalla.com/en/contact

## Hosted workshops
There are no public tickets. A host inquires to book a half-day or full-day session, in person or online. Custom topics (branding, sales, productivity, ideation) can still be facilitated.

- Index: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops
- Book: https://www.roalla.com/en/contact?intent=workshop

- Focus Circle — priorities, a simple kanban, and support from the people around you: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/focus-circle
- The Workload Conversation — make workload visible and agree trade-offs before overload: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/workload-conversation
- Digital Calm — reduce digital noise and protect attention without disconnecting: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/digital-calm
- The Decision Hour — end meetings with one owner, one trade-off, and a written next step: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/decision-hour
- The Offer on One Page — say the same offer in the sales conversation, on the website, and in the proposal: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/offer-page
- The Shortlist — generate ideas inside a constraint and leave with one experiment: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/ideation
- The First Offer — for young founders and high school teams: one person, one sentence, one proof before a site, app, or pitch: https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/first-offer

French workshop paths use /fr/ in place of /en/. Example: https://www.roalla.com/fr/programs/workshops/focus-circle

## Answers
- What does ROALLA do? ROALLA assesses, builds, optimizes, and evolves digital assets—websites, products, automation, visibility, events—and facilitates hosted workshops.
- Where is ROALLA based? Burlington, Ontario, Canada. Clients are served globally.
- How do I start? Submit a service inquiry at https://www.roalla.com/en/contact or take the five-question assessment at https://www.roalla.com/en/assessment
- Are workshop tickets sold online? No. Hosts inquire. There is no public ticket checkout.
- Who facilitates the workshops? Steven Robin. Sessions are educational. They are not therapy, medical advice, or an employment assessment.
- What website packages exist? Launch $999, Launch + Visibility $1,999, Growth from $2,999, Custom from $5,000. Details: https://www.roalla.com/en/website-package
